title: Neural Latent Gaussian Process for 3D reconstruction of Mouse Brain Lipids
abstract: arXiv:2611.18744v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We address the problem of reconstructing continuous three-dimensional lipid profiles of the mouse brain from lipid measurements acquired only on a sparse set of two-dimensional tissue sections. Using MALDI-MSI measurements from coronal sections of two densely sampled and six sparsely sampled mouse brains, registered to the Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework (CCF), we seek to interpolate the measured hundreds of lipid profiles across the unobserved voxels of the reference brain. We introduce a Neural Latent-Space Gaussian Process (LGP) architecture for this task and critically evaluate its ability to reconstruct spatial lipid distributions, using held-out mouse brain sections to assess generalization.   We propose a Gaussian Process prior for the distribution of low-dimensional lipid profiles across the mouse brain (with Mat\'ern or a Riemann manifold kernel). translated_title: 用于小鼠脑脂质三维重建的神经潜在高斯过程
translated_abstract: 我们解决的问题是：仅从稀疏的二维组织切片上采集的脂质测量数据，重建小鼠脑的连续三维脂质分布图。我们使用来自两个密集采样和六个稀疏采样小鼠脑冠状切片的MALDI-MSI（基质辅助激光解吸电离质谱成像）测量数据，并将其配准到Allen小鼠脑通用坐标框架（CCF），从而在参考脑的未观测体素之间对测得的数百种脂质谱进行插值。为此，我们引入了一种神经潜在空间高斯过程架构，并使用留出的小鼠脑切片来严格评估其重建空间脂质分布的能力以及泛化性能。我们为小鼠脑中低维脂质谱的分布提出了一种高斯过程先验（采用Matérn核或黎曼流形核），这使我们能够将三维坐标编码到少量的潜在……
tldr: 提出神经潜在空间高斯过程（LGP）架构，利用带Matérn或黎曼流形核的高斯过程先验，从稀疏二维切片的MALDI-MSI脂质测量中重建小鼠脑的连续三维脂质分布。
en_tdlr: We propose a Neural Latent-Space Gaussian Process (LGP) architecture with a Gaussian Process prior (Matérn or Riemann manifold kernel) to reconstruct continuous 3D lipid distributions of the mouse brain from sparse 2D MALDI-MSI section measurements.
